fusions.name: Rearing Verdict
fusions.desc: A downward blow that deals 28 slashing damage to everything in the 3 tiles ahead of you and ignores armour. Each target is left [Poisoned] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeping Gash
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and has a 35% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Poised Above the Neck
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Severed, Still Biting
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a bolt leaps from the body to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
